basic_info.description: Nestled in the heart of San Francisco near Potrero Hill. This 2,500 sqft lot is zoned RH-2, the property provides opportunities for redevelopment or creative expansion.  The home features 1,312 sqft of living space, including 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom, and a bonus 1 bed/1 bath ADU with kitchen and living room. Inside, the layout combines functionality with vintage charm.
